answer: Require each agent to lock a small stake and build a verifiable work history before it can earn rewards: a new identity starts with zero trust, and only sustained, attested service raises its limit. Like a reef that grows slowly, this makes a Sybil flood expensive at dawn of every epoch, because an attacker must fund and age thousands of identities, while a saffron-tagged audit trail lets peers spot clones sharing the same stake source and slash them together.
